yuvasena.g: m. N. of a poet, Cat.

yuvati.g: f. a girl, young woman, any young female animal, RV. &c. &c.

yuvatisambogakara.g: m. N. of a poet, Cat.

yuvatisarta.g: m. a multitude of young women, Ratnāv..

yuvavalina.g: mf n. having wrinkles in youth, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 67, Sch.

yuvavat.g: mfn. belonging to both of you, ib.

yuvayu.g: mfn. longing for you both, RV.

yuvayuj.g: mfn. yoked or harnessed by both of you, ib.

yuyjana.g: mfn. uniting, joining, arranging, performing, Kathās.; BhP.

yuyjanaka.g: mfn. containing the word yuYjAna, g. gozad-Adi.

yuyjanda.g: m. or n. N. of a place, Cat.

yuyudan.g: m. N. of a king of Mithilā, BhP.

yuyujanasapti.g: mfn. one who has yoked his horses, RV. vi, 62, 4.

yuyutsa.g: f. the wishing to fight, desire for war, pugnacity, combativeness, MBh.; Hariv.; R.

yuyutsarahita.g: mfn. without wish or intention to fight, cowardly, W.

yuyutsu.g: mfn. wishing to fight, eager for battle, pugnacious, MBh.; Kāv.

yuz.g: cl. 1. P. yUzati, to hurt, kill, Dhātup. xvii, 29.

yuza.g: m. n. soup, broth, pease-soup, the water in which pulse of various kinds has been boiled, GṛŚrS.; Kathās.; Suśr.

yuzma.g: the actual base of the 2nd pers. pron. in the pl. number.

yuzmad.g: also considered by native grammarians to be the base of the cases yuzmA/n &c.

yuzmadartam.g: ind. for you, on your account, MW.

yuzmadayatta.g: mfn. dependent upon you, at your disposal, ib.

yuzmadfs.g: mf n. like you, similar to you, one such as you, Kathās.

yuzmadiya.g: mfn. belonging to you, your, yours, Kathās.

yuzmadvida.g: mfn. of your kind or sort, like you, BhP.

yuzmezita.g: mfn. excited or instigated by you, ib.

yuzmota.g: mfn. protected or loved by you, ib.

yuzwagrama.g: m. N. of a village, Rājat.

yvaguli.g: f. sour scum of boiled rice, L..
